title: Shadow DOM retargeting + pointer-events:auto → e.target lies; use composedPath()[0] + disable pointer-events for caretRangeFromPoint
trigger: Floating Shadow DOM popup with pointer-events:auto intercepts clicks on page text behind it
principle: When a visible Shadow DOM popup has pointer-events:auto, it intercepts all clicks within its area. e.target is retargeted to the host element (not the actual clicked shadow child), so target.closest('button') fails. Use e.composedPath()[0] to get the real clicked element. For non-interactive areas, fall through to caretRangeFromPoint wrapped in a helper that temporarily sets pointer-events:none on all UI hosts so the caret can see page text behind the popup.

cases.context: Dictionary popup (Shadow DOM, pointer-events:auto when visible) covers page text. User clicks on text behind popup — mouseup target is the popup host, not the page text.
cases.bad: if (target?.closest(UI_HOST_SELECTORS)) { return; } // swallows ALL clicks on popup, including non-interactive areas covering page text

applyFor: Shadow DOM overlays that need click-through to page content
Floating popups with pointer-events:auto covering interactive page elements
Any Shadow DOM event handler where e.target is retargeted to host
caretRangeFromPoint calls that need to see through floating UI
